title: 16 Pages
overview: A not so good in his mind director tries to get funding for his new film

title: Far from Maine
overview: Haunted by the killing by Israeli police of a Palestinian friend from his youth, an Israeli queer filmmaker embarks on a cinematic dialogue across time — confronting memory, friendship, and the genocide unfolding today.  In this intimate cinematic letter, Israeli filmmaker Roy Cohen addresses his Palestinian friend and fellow peace activist Aseel Aslih, who was murdered by Israeli police in their youth. Cohen tells Aslih of his experiences navigating a growingly genocidal society and seeks Aslih’s moral clarity and resilience in the evocative letters he had written as a teenager.

title: Lucky Strike
overview: A wounded American soldier fights to survive behind enemy lines during WWII's Battle of the Bulge against the Germans, relying on his instinct, spy craft and a hand-radio to evade capture and find his way back to his unit.

title: Notes
overview: Meet Martí, an ordinary guy who spends his days living in a closed-off routine inside his house, and discover the reason that will make him lose his mind.

title: Senior Options: The Movie
overview: A documentary showcasing the individuals of the Edgemont High School Class of 2026 through the lens of Senior Options, a unique student-focused program.

title: MIN(D/E)
overview: In the ruins of post-disaster West Java, a child escapes from a rehabilitation center and tries to find meaning and well-being in life.

title: Another Iced Coffee
overview: Two friends meet for coffee, but a chance encounter with a drunken stranger sends their night in an unexpected direction.

title: The Blind Girl and an Elephant
overview: Three girls try to flee their village to escape the superstitions and fanatic hostility surrounding them. Only the blind girl makes it out, finding herself face-to-face with an elephant.

title: Veronica's Secret
overview: A girl's disappearance spirals into unraveling a dark past and its secrets.

title: RedLine
overview: "Ajoy" a mechanic who has a high ego and prestige wants to get more money for fame and success, along with his friend "Biluy" who is also a mechanic. "Ajoy" began to plan and invite "biluy" to join him in illegal racing at night. On the other hand, the car they used in the illegal race was their customer's car which made the situation and atmosphere that night began to worry "Biluy". Until when they finished the race everything felt in vain, to the point where they had to run from the car owner's pursuit.

title: Creative Differences
overview: A rock band are sent to a countryside retreat to write their next album.

title: 40 Dates and 40 Nights
overview: A struggling romantic accepts her aunt's wager: go on 40 dates in 40 nights to find true love. If she fails, her aunt will cover her rent and student debt. But the journey proves more challenging than expected.

title: Circo Zarathustra
overview: Drawing on the vast body of Nietzsche’s work and weaving together his writings and his thought, Leonardo Petrillo has created a remarkable work that analyses the paradoxical, at times extreme and contradictory thinking of modernity’s most controversial philosopher.

title: Night of Blood
overview: Six strangers enter a cash-prize endurance challenge at the Val Verde Hotel, a location infamous for a fatal explosion and rumors of being haunted. Instead of being stalked by a physical, masked serial killer, the contestants face immersive, supernatural scares when the hauntings at the hotel turn out to be all too real.

title: Yet Again Another Great Chase
overview: The Chase Continues, but is this it?

title: Your Fault: London
overview: Nick and Noah are both embarking on life-changing adventures that are threatening to pull them apart—Nick in business with his father and Noah starting a fresh chapter at Oxford University. Now living separate lives, and meeting new people, they find themselves entangled in temptations, rivalries, and betrayals and their bond is tested like never before. As secrets unravel and temptation rises, they must fight to hold onto each other—or risk losing everything.

title: Leviticus
overview: Two teenage boys must escape a violent entity that takes the form of the person they desire most — each other.

title: RECOIL
overview: THE MAFIA.  A LIST.  A HITMAN.  Edgar is a hitman for a Mafia in Lille. One night, his boss gives him a list of people to eliminate for the safety of the mafia.

title: Extreme Makeover: Homer Edition
overview: Homer and Marge's fun couples' date night goes off the rails when Marge learns Homer left the kids unsupervised with only the doorbell camera as a babysitter. Frustrated with her imperfect husband, a tipsy Marge stirs up a trilogy of fantasies of a different Homer.

title: Jim Queen
overview: When Heterosis - a mysterious virus that turns gay men straight sweeps through the Parisian gay scene, Jim, the six packed sovereign of the Gym Queens, goes from Pride royalty to social outcast. With only Lucien, a freshly-out twink with more heart than abs, still by his side, Jim must race to find a cure before the disease erases the community that once worshipped him.

title: Bom Trabalho
overview: Every day, Pereira arrives at work and follows the instructions that appear on his computer screen. At the same time, an omniscient voice narrates each of his movements, anticipating his actions as if it knew his destiny. In a world governed by commands and certainties, everything seems to work perfectly. Until a small decision threatens to disrupt the order of things.

title: Checkout: The Movie
overview: The supermarket workers leave the sleepy supermarket in Yavneh for a crazy adventure in which they are accused of a serious crime in a plot that begins in a detention cell and countinues with an escape story of Shefa Isasschar in an attempt to save their good name.

title: Babymetal Live at Intuit Dome
overview: Celebrating their 15th anniversary, and as part of their 2025/2026 world tour, BABYMETAL made history as the first Japanese group to hold a one-man live show and sell out said show at the Intuit Dome in Los Angeles!

title: The Stories
overview: The Stories is a decades-spanning Egyptian family saga and love story set between the late 1960s and 1980s. The film follows Ahmed, a young man from a Middle-Class Cairo family who dreams of becoming a concert pianist. During the tense summer of 1967, as war looms over Egypt, he begins a pen-pal correspondence with an Austrian woman named Elizabeth (“Liz”). A semi-autobiographical film based on the director's parents and how they met.

title: Ulysse
overview: Alice, a sociology researcher, and Volodymyr, a pianist, are going to have a child! They will call him Ulysses. Except that Ulysses, at one year old, doesn't fit the growth charts. Too small, too thin, and he still isn't walking. The verdict comes down: Ulysses won't be like the others. But how will he be?

title: the guy that lives on my front yard
overview: Grey wakes to find a stranger living in a tent on his front lawn. Unable to physically remove him, he is forced to allow the man to steadily encroach on every aspect of his life. When confronted about the man by someone close to him, Grey is compelled to seek a more vulnerable method: coexisting with this presence he cannot escape.

title: The Margins
overview: A nighttime journey into the abyss, where medieval marginalia perform an everlasting bureaucratic ritual in which the ticket becomes a fragile sacrifice.

title: The Exhibitor
overview: As murders begin to surface around hotels and expos, suspicion around Vi begins to close in. With her past resurfacing and her behavior growing harder to read, one question lingers: What is she really hiding?

title: Home Along da Riles: Da Reunion
overview: Years after Kevin Cosme's death, his children strive to uphold the values he taught them. Tensions arise when Bing announces her plan to marry her mysterious long-time boyfriend, prompting her brothers Bill, Bob, Baldo, and Estong to attempt to stop the wedding. Meanwhile, Azon, Kevin's widow, becomes saddened by the children's growing disunity and apparent abandonment of the values they were raised with, while imagining visions of Kevin as if he were still alive.

title: Shana
overview: Shana navigates the trials and tribulations of everyday life with boundless energy and the support of her group of friends. When her grandmother passes away, she inherits a ring that is supposed to protect her from bad luck. Shana certainly needs this helping hand. Especially since her toxic partner has been released from prison, and misfortunes are piling up…

title: The Giaccomo
overview: To reach a million followers, Giaccomo will stop at nothing. From Amiens to Dubai, the dizzying rise of an influencer ready to push all boundaries to blow up the buzz.

title: Toy Story 5
overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

title: The Furious
overview: After Wang Wei's daughter is kidnapped by a criminal network and he receives no help from the corrupt police, Wei sets out to find her himself. His only ally is Navin, a relentless journalist whose wife has mysteriously disappeared. Fueled by a furious vengeance, the unlikely duo ruthlessly battle the kidnappers in this explosive martial arts showdown.

title: Little Brother
overview: A tightly wound realtor's picture-perfect life gets an extreme makeover when his lovably chaotic "little brother" suddenly reappears.

title: Maa Inti Bangaram
overview: Through both her moments of fear and bravery, a woman discovers that embracing her vulnerabilities is as vital to her inner strength as facing challenges head-on.

title: The Death of Robin Hood
overview: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

title: Strung
overview: A talented violinist whose prestigious new role as a music tutor for an enigmatic, elite family spirals into a psychological battle for her safety and sanity.

title: Girls Like Girls
overview: Coley, 17, from rural Oregon, navigates intimacy after her mother's passing. Meeting Sonya sparks new feelings, but self-doubt hinders their connection. Sonya, unfamiliar with dating girls, is uncertain. They learn to embrace emotions.

title: Confined
overview: The story of a gang put together by a crime boss in order to pull off a heist. It all seems to be going well, until it’s not. The crew gets broken up after the heist due to external circumstances, and upon reuniting, there is undeniable tension between the men. They are confined to a hideout in a remote location, waiting to hear from the boss. But the question is - how long will they be able to trust each other?

title: Blind spot
overview: After committing an irreparable act, a young deaf man seeks oblivion by isolating himself in a country house. As he resumes his normal life, paranormal phenomena begin to haunt his daily existence.

title: The Get Out
overview: A nightclub owner is on the verge of leaving his dangerous past behind for retirement with his girlfriend. When masked gunmen rob him and he finds himself squeezed by ruthless cartels, a mysterious newcomer arrives with an interest in buying the business. With danger closing in from all sides, he must navigate a deadly web of deception, power, and survival  -  where escape may no longer be an option.

title: METILNATOR I
overview: After a serious accident, Metil dies, but his brother decides to turn him into a cyborg. Following a psychotic episode, Metilnator kills his brother and embarks on a quest for revenge against an unexpected figure.

title: Cerita Lila
overview: Two twins named Lila and Lili. Both experienced tragic ends after alleged abuse by their own mother, Rahma. However, death does not immediately end their story. In another realm, Lila continues to search for her twin sister, Lili, who was separated from her. This search then leads Lila into a greater mystery that has been hidden. In addition to facing a deep sense of loss, Lila also tries to understand the reasons behind the tragedy that destroyed their lives. Meanwhile, mysterious figures begin to appear and reveal that there is a greater power deliberately hiding the truth.

title: Les abeilles ne sont pas encore mortes.
overview: After receiving devastating news one morning, Esther, a silent young girl, goes through her daily routine while a darker reality gradually unfolds.

title: Original Night
overview: Told in two semi-fictional acts, this 16mm film serves as an elegy for Europe’s last wallabies — a marsupial animal from Australia, introduced in Scotland in the 1940s. Reflecting on humanity’s enduring urge to record animals, from prehistoric cave art to early cinema, Alasdair Asmussen Doyle links the extinction of species with the evolution of image-making.

title: Shells: Shaped by Nature
overview: Since the dawn of time, Nature has sculpted the oceans with her delicate hand, weaving the tapestry of life in the shimmering depths and sunlit shallows. With infinite care, she conjured snails and mollusks to inhabit diverse marine realms around the African continent, each a reflection of her boundless creativity and wisdom. These delicate spirals, with their tender curves, ensnare our imagination, inspiring art, shaping cultures, adorning garments, and even serving as currency in ancient economies. "Shells: Shaped by Nature" is an artistic tribute to the enigmatic splendor of shells, celebrating these intricate marvels that grace Africa’s marine realms.

title: Les Heures Mortes
overview: Camel, 20 years old, stifled by the violence of his social condition and his factory job, one day unintentionally triggers a global shutdown with a single sentence he utters. He nevertheless meets a girl his own age, unlike any other, who will offer him answers and a day outside of time that he will be forced to forget forever.

title: Maiin Haan
overview: Inspired by true events from 2007, Main Haan follows Seerat, a young woman haunted by an unseen presence after moving to Delhi. As terrifying incidents escalate, a shocking truth emerges—a restless spirit is using her to reveal an unfinished story connected to Sarab, the man she loves.

title: Huí Jiā
overview: An aging restaurant owner reflects on an old letter she once sent to her father in her homeland.

title: Slackers
overview: A slingshot is loaded, the stone flies and crashes - the neighbor's window breaks. Ramona and Nico are friends, lazy bums and fresh out of school. But instead of thinking about their future, they prefer to let the hot Berlin summer get the better of them. When they release a beloved neighbor's bird, they have to flee - into the politically charged world that they really don't want to be in. A road trip through Berlin begins - but on foot.

title: Rusty Bearclaw and The Rucket List
overview: An LDS teenager receives his call to serve a mission for his church. Realizing he doesn't have long before he leaves for two years, he creates a "pre-mission bucket list" to complete alongside his two idiotic best friends.

title: Andy Lau “TODAY…is the Day” Hong Kong Concert Tour 2024/25
overview: This concert was professionally filmed for the Hong Kong show, as part of Andy Lau's most recent tour across 72 shows from 5th July 2024 to 10th January 2025

title: Nuclear Boy
overview: The lonely 17-year-old outcast Aike craves attention and finds it online where he conducts dangerous chemistry experiments. Hoping to pull Aike out of his internet bubble, his mother, a hardworking nurse, sends him to the scouts to make real friends. When that fails, Aike feels rejected and hurt. To prove himself to the world, he begins his biggest experiment yet: he secretly builds a nuclear breeder reactor in his mother's shed, encouraged by a growing group of internet followers.

title: Робоняня
overview: Cheerful and inventive Zlata, who stays at home alone for the sake of the school ball and the first kiss, under the supervision of the newest robot nanny Notrix. Confident that she can easily trick the car, Zlata soon discovers that she is dealing with an invulnerable opponent who controls the entire house. Desperate, she and her neighbor Nikita, who is in love with her, find an unconventional way out - they begin to communicate with the robot in its language, using "perfect promts". Their friendship with their iron friend is rapidly gaining momentum and leads to a huge party, which turns into real chaos. It is at this moment that Zlata has to make a choice and understand what true friendship and self-sacrifice are.

title: Here The Whole Time
overview: An insecure teenager's vacation plans are ruined by an unexpected visitor: his neighbor and school crush who will spend two weeks sleeping at his house. The days that promised peace, tranquility and epic series marathons end up bringing a whirlwind of feelings and unresolved issues.

title: Queen at Sea
overview: As advanced dementia erodes an older woman’s ability to communicate her inner life, her husband and daughter struggle to act in her best interests, navigating love and the fragile boundaries between care, protection and autonomy.

title: Cocktail 2
overview: After a decade together, Diya and Kunal's relationship is shaken when Ally, an old friend, re-enters their lives. What begins as a plan between two women spirals into chaos, triggering hilarious, emotional rollercoaster none of them saw coming.

title: Voicemails for Isabelle
overview: A young woman's hilariously confessional voicemails to her late sister are unknowingly redirected to a stranger, who begins to fall in love from afar.

title: Citizen Vigilante
overview: Wealthy American landlord living in a small European country declares migrants as main cause to rampant crime wave and decides to eradicate them. His brutal vigilante methods put him in crosshairs of local Interpol chief.

title: Husbands in Action
overview: A detective teams up with his ex-wife's new husband to chase down her kidnappers. Can this unlikely duo put aside their differences for one wild rescue?

title: Balan - The Boy
overview: A teenage boy searches for his missing mother following a turbulent childhood and her subsequent disappearance, exploring his search for closure and the truth about his past.

title: Ghabadkund
overview: Ghabadkund is the first Marathi cinematic universe-a gripping blend of suspense, action adventure. In a mysterious village, a string of unexplained events pulls an outsider into a hidden world of secrets tied to the legend of Ghabadkund

title: Latina
overview: A story about a mysterious woman who shakes up a seemingly ordinary boarding house. As she charms both the boys and girls, secrets unravel, relationships collide, and chaos takes over.

title: Chainsaw Man Mobile Game - Opening Movie
overview: The anime "Chainsaw Man" is getting a smartphone game adaptation. Opening movie [Opening Theme] MAXIMUM THE HORMONE.

title: I Know Who You Are
overview: On the day of the 1949 Founding Ceremony, Xiao Dali (Lei Jiayin), who has just entered the city to be reorganized as the head of the public security police station, discovers that Feng Jingbo (Hu Ge), an elementary school teacher, is suspected of being suspicious. With the high alertness of a soldier and the sense of responsibility of a public security warrior, he is hard-partnered with Feng Jingbo as a neighbor, exhausting his life through trials and tribulations, and carrying out a nearly four-decade tracking without complaint or regret. The movie is based on Zhang Ce's novel.

title: Yene Semay
overview: A Film By Kirubel Seyoum

title: The Samurai and the Prisoner
overview: When Lord Murashige rises up against the tyrannical Oda, he finds himself besieged within the walls of his own castle. Isolated, he is confronted with a series of mysterious crimes that shatter the fragile order of his court, plunging the fortress into fear and suspicion. With Oda's army closing in and a traitor hiding among his ranks, Murashige is forced into an uneasy alliance with Kanbei, a brilliant and dangerous strategist held prisoner in the dungeon, as he must outwit his enemies and uncover the truth before time runs out.

title: MASTERCLASS
overview: In a time without space, a group of actors desperately try to stage a play under the supervision of a computer.

title: It's My Time
overview: 70 year old Shen Yanhong (played by Yang Ziqiong) was sent to a nursing home by her son after falling seriously ill, and the house was also rented out by her son. In order to regain her life, she tried to make money but encountered obstacles everywhere. Just as she was about to give up, her talent in the Rubik's Cube was discovered by young Rubik's Cube coach Xiao Wu. One wants to make money and leave the nursing home, while the other wants to save the dying Rubik's Cube training class. The two hit it off and appeared on TV programs. From the beginning, she not only gained fame and fortune, attention, dignity, love, and initiative in life, but also brought vitality to the stagnant nursing home. She was not afraid of failure, fought against aging and prejudice, and arrived at the highest stage of the Rubik's Cube all the way. Finally, with her son's encouragement, she completed an extremely difficult challenge and won the Guinness World Record.

title: Secert in the Box
overview: Remake and update on Au Yeung Ping Keung’s murder mystery after his death

title: Fatherland
overview: In 1949, German writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika embark on a road trip across a Germany in ruins, from US-dominated Frankfurt to Soviet-controlled Weimar.

title: Nooru Sami
overview: Selvi, a widowed mother, devotes her life to raising her two sons in a conservative village. Years later, unfulfilled life comes back into focus, challenging deep-rooted traditions. As family and society strongly oppose change, Selvi must choose between societal expectations and her own happiness.

title: Alice
overview: Living in a dreary, cookie-cutter world of conformity, Alice, a dreamy young girl, steps into Wonderland for an extraordinary night.  - A short film by the film department of the Maison des Arts - UPEC Fontainebleau.

title: All of a Sudden
overview: Marie-Lou Fontaine, director of a nursing home in the Paris suburbs, defies convention by adopting the 'Humanitude' method despite her team’s resistance. Her encounter with Mari Morisaki, a terminally ill Japanese playwright, transforms her life. Together, they turn the facility into a symbol of resistance and humanity against the system’s limits.

title: Chaali Din
overview: Chaali Din is an adaption of best selling punjabi novel of the same name. This gripping story by Gurpreet Dhugga delves into the complexities of human emotions and relationships over a transformative 40-day journey. The book explores themes of love, loss, redemption, and self-discovery through vivid storytelling and well-drawn characters. With its gripping narrative and profound insights, this work captures the essence of life’s challenges and triumphs.

title: The Boy Who Counted Cars
overview: Have you ever felt incredibly alone in the world? Have you ever suspected that everything around you is unreal?  Ah Zhi is a strange young man who spends his spare time searching for evidence that this world is a virtual world. He spends his spare time searching for proof that this world is a virtual one, until the appearance of a quirky girl named Xiao Yi, who makes him almost give up on the search for the truth. Through the fast-igniting love between Ah Zhi and Xiao Yi, life seems so romantic and real. But is Xiao Yi an NPC in a virtual game or the perfect lover in real life, and can they live happily ever after in this world? ......

title: Land of Wolves
overview: When a covert rescue mission goes wrong, four former Navy SEALs are captured and thrown into an underground death match. Watched by depraved billionaires, they are forced to fight in a brutal tournament. With no weapons and no way out, the team must rely on their training and unbreakable bond to survive the bloody arena, dismantle the entire operation and reclaim their freedom.

title: Riakoi First Love
overview: Twenty-seven-year-old Sawako Okazaki works for an event-planning company and finds purpose in supporting her favorite idol, Kaisei Komaki. When her employer signs him and staff compete for the chance to manage his events, Sawako throws herself into the opportunity. Her admiration gradually becomes real love, but a woman claiming to be Kaisei’s girlfriend and harassment inside and outside the company shake her confidence. As Kaisei begins to trust her, he suddenly disappears. Sawako must overcome the setbacks and discover whether her devotion can become a genuine romance.

title: A House Most Haunted
overview: When a man clears out his childhood home to put on the market, he and his friend discover his parents' past seance records and hypnosis journals - awakening something that should have stayed buried.

title: Maddie's Secret
overview: Maddie is a plucky dishwasher who leaps to viral superstardom at a trendy food content creation company. While her life seems picturesque — complete with an adoring husband, ride-or-die best friend and a cupboard full of woman-owned ethically-sourced chili crisp to boot — mounting professional pressures threaten to reawaken a hidden secret from her troubled past.

title: Branches of a Fig Tree
overview: In a peaceful world recovering from catastrophe, a spirited runaway meets a magnetic community leader. As they fall in love, they discover truths about connection, the world, and their pasts- and realise they might be more connected than they thought.

title: Oreste
overview: Oreste is caught up in an obsessive search for a girl who perfectly matches his bizarre ideals, as he wanders through a sweltering summer in Rome.

title: Effi o Blaenau
overview: Hard-partying young woman Effi lives in rural Wales, whose life largely revolves around drinking vodka with her friends and eating instant noodles to cure her subsequent hangovers – until her life suddenly changes dramatically.

title: You Are the Film
overview: The directorial debut of Makoto Ueda, the award-winning writer of such films as Beyond the Infinite Two Minutes, River, Night is Short Walk on Girl, etc

title: Invictus
overview: In both work and life, Liu Hao had always been the one looked down upon. That is, until he met Cai Cai—two young souls who fell deeply in love. Just as they were brimming with confidence, ready to embark on a bright future, a sudden accident overturned their lives completely. Faced with a cruel world and a humiliating existence, they chose divergent paths of resistance...

title: Virginia Woolf's Night & Day
overview: In 1910 London, independent-minded Katharine Hilbery defies her family's expectations of marriage to pursue a career in astronomy. But when her father pressures her into an unwanted engagement, her resolve is tested. Through new friendships—including a bold suffragette and a thoughtful editor—Katharine begins to question the limits placed on her by society, love, and tradition, ultimately searching for a path that is truly her own.

title: Benjamin Tranié - Félicitations et tout et tout
Cheer Dad
overview: When a young girl and her family move to a new town, she yearns for a sense of belonging. She finds it by joining her school's cheerleading squad. Inspired by her new found love and dedication to the sport, her adoptive father comes out for support and is soon recruited as the assistant coach. As the father and daughter grow together, they'll see if they have what it takes to win the championship.

title: Alive
overview: After coming face to face with death, 40-year-old Nora is consumed by an urgent need to feel alive. She dives into passionate relationships with two very different men, Tom and Max, whose opposing natures reflect her own inner conflict. But when neither can fill the void, Nora is forced to face the truth, she will have to confront a deeper fear driving her hunger for life.

title: 7 Piano Sketches
overview: A piano tuner wanders through the streets of New York after dark, seeking artistic inspiration. Sketchbook in hand, he observes the city’s lovers, mourners, and giant ants from afar. But when a twist of fate brings him face-to-face with a kindred spirit, he finds what he was looking for all along.

title: Pickleball
overview: When foreclosure threatens their community center, Father Joseph rallies his late friend’s sons into an underdog pickleball team for a $100,000 tournament—against a cocky tennis legend determined to seize the courts and steal the spotlight.

title: Alerta Roja
overview: Midpoint Presents: Alerta Roja (Red Alert)  She entered the bathroom thinking she'd only be there for a few minutes...  Based on unfortunately possible events.

title: Strangers in the Mountain
overview: In the 1990s, two police officers ventured into the mountains along Zhejiang's Shanxi Stream to track down a suspect from an old case. As they dug deeper into the past, long-buried memories resurfaced, stirring poignant recollections among everyone involved about Zhang Xue, the person who had gone missing.

title: Stepfather
overview: After years of eradicating any family that falls short of perfection, Darnell believes his new wife Asia and her daughters might finally be the real deal. That is, until tensions rise and they uncover his deadly pattern. Now, getting rid of them won’t be as easy as he planned.

title: Peter Asher: Everywhere Man
overview: Peter Asher’s extraordinary life has intersected with some of the greatest artists and musical moments of the last six decades. A child actor who became a pop star and then a manager and producer to the likes of James Taylor and Linda Ronstadt, he is a Zelig-like figure who remains a vital creative force to this day. Featuring interviews with Paul McCartney, Carole King, and many more.

title: Deewana
overview: Munna, an ordinary boy in an ordinary world, sees a beauty that feels beyond his reach. While he struggles to become worthy of her, she is quietly learning to leave.

title: Unidentified
overview: The body of a teenage girl is found in the heart of the desert, he raised many questions about the girl's personality, the lady decides to search for the circumstances of the crime and collect information about the unknown body, and solves the mystery surrounded by the crime.

title: Midnight City
overview: Dutch Lazarus is a detective who specializes in strange cases. When a new client walks into his office and stymies him at every turn, we begin to wonder what her game is, and if Dutch already knows a lot more more than she's telling.

title: Then You Said It
overview: Two best friends realise they both have feelings for each other. But will they confess? And what will happen if they do?

title: Her Private Hell
overview: When a mysterious mist engulfs a futuristic metropolis, unleashing a deadly and elusive entity, a troubled young woman searches for her father. Her quest collides with an American GI on a harrowing odyssey to rescue his daughter from Hell.

title: The Belladonna
overview: Haunted by visions of her late mother, a burlesque dancer’s paranoia deepens when she becomes convinced a fellow performer is plotting to steal her crown as Queen of the Belladonna Club.

title: Langkah
overview: Laffet, a village boy who wants to move to the city, is in conflict with his father who strongly rejects his decision. Mamak tried to calm him down, but Laffet still left. In the city he works, but missing his family continues to haunt him. When he finally returned home, he found only an empty house and signs of loss that he could not prevent

title: Catsitting
overview: A teen documenting his catsitting job finds that there's more in this house than he thinks...

title: Mama?
overview: The caged bird sings with a fearful trill of things unknown but longed for still and his tune is heard on the distant hill for the caged bird sings of freedom

title: Detective McMan in the LABYRINTH OF LIES
overview: When movie director Howard Morrison is murdered, polar opposite detectives Geoffrey McMan and Drake Blake must solve the case. Can they find who murdered Howard Morrison before more people die, or will they themselves die trying?

title: The Love Heist
overview: Celebrity stylist Kayli must team up with hotel security chief Mills to track down an iconic piece of fashion history after it goes missing on her watch before the Chicago Costume Gala.

title: The Price of Greatness
overview: Trapped between a radical philosophy and a rotting conscience, a destitute sociology student commits a ‘necessary’ murder to mirror history’s greatest revolutionaries, only to find his intellectual awakening transformed into a slow descent into madness under the gaze of a relentless detective.

title: DOOM
overview: The bubbling underbelly of Hell

title: Sitting
overview: Four friends gather for drinks. As the night deepens, reason quietly slips out of the door, and drunken madness takes its seat at the head of the table.

title: Loneliness and the Sheep
overview: We follow the trip of a heartbroken man. Long after his break up, he cannot let it leave his mind continuously searching for meaning in every mundane thing, only to ultimately find peace in the carelessly afraid sheep at the footsteps of Mont Saint-Michel.

title: Eclosión
overview: In a forgotten laboratory, a brilliant but obsessed inventor brings to life his most promising creation: the Hatchling. Fragile yet full of promise, the creature becomes the focus of both care and experimentation. As the line between legacy and control begins to blur, Eclosión explores the price of perfection and whether love can survive obsession.

title: Stardust
overview: When his father brings his new girlfriend to the seaside, a withdrawn boy is forced to share his grief with someone he doesn't want to know.

title: Mimi The Mime
overview: A homeless mime and a struggling clown fight over the attention of a crowd on a NYC sidewalk.  When their fight draws more attention and money than their performances ever could, they  realize they struck gold. Broke, desperate and out of options, the pair transform their slapstick  routines into an underground bare-knuckle sensation called ‘Mime vs Clown’.

title: Married Alive
overview: Single dad Mack & his soon-to-be-married son Tony may not survive their off-road camping trip when their Jeep overturns, trapping Tony underneath. With a storm coming, Mack has to find help to save his son from drowning.

title: Housepainter
overview: A paroled house painter in Venice Beach's life brutally falls apart over the course of a few bad days.

title: Loset
overview: Art film about hiker who stuck in forest and became insane in every second

overview: The woman gets entangled with joy and euphoria. Romantic porn that depicts the reality of a swamping couple swapping in Scandinavia! Along with Norway, which is called the country of the night, on the Scandinavian peninsula, Sweden is known worldwide as a free sex developed country, now with the advent of the sex liberation era

title: The Street Photographer
overview: Matthijs is a street photographer in Amsterdam, aiming to succeed and grow within his profession. A new client gives him a unique photography assignment: create a photo that captures the spirit of art in Amsterdam.  Matthijs travels the city in search of the best photo, ultimately learning not only what he considers the essence of true art, but also how he can become a better artist himself.

title: For the Love of a Woman
overview: 1970s. Esther, living in America, receives a mysterious letter after her mother's death. She is asked to locate a woman living in 1930s Palestine who is keeping a secret related to her life. Esther arrives in Israel and contacts Professor Zaida who will help her in her search.  1930s. Pioneer colony in the valley, a new world atmosphere. Moshe, a widower and father of two, hires a woman to help him maintain the house. The arrival of Yehudit stirs up his life and the lives of two other men: Yaakov, a romantic farmer, and Globerman, a cattle dealer.  In a romantic triangle, the threads between past and present intertwine and Esther and Zaida discover a shocking truth.

title: Malus Domesticated
overview: The story of the peculiar relationship between a man and his sentient, possessive house who won't let him leave.

title: Swechha Teeram
overview: A young man's plan to impress his girlfriend's father takes a comic turn when their meeting turns into a challenge that could decide the future of their love.

title: Lifeline
overview: How far would you go, and what would you risk for the one you love? What drives Ananya, a city girl, to this distant village and where will her journey lead?

title: The Monkey bar
overview: Three childhood friends return to their favorite college bar a night before a wedding ,only to discover that the bar remembers them. The stools they sit on unlock personal truths they've buried for years. Guided by the spirits of Gandhi’s three monkeys, they see, hear, and speak the uncomfortable realities they’ve long avoided ,and leave the night changed forever.

title: The Next Karate Kid
overview: Twelve-year-old Sasha is forced to leave Moscow for Pyatigorsk to live with his aunt while his doctor parents are on assignment in Africa. Local children, school bullying, and conflict with the leader, Marat, become part of his new life. When his parents disappear during a flood, the boy faces utter despair. Seeking strength, he discovers a passion-karate, where his strict sensei, Dmitriy, and his daughter, Masha, help him overcome his fears, develop his character, and find inner strength.

title: Argiope
overview: After what seemed like a promising first date, Julián wakes up tied to a chair in a dark room, bleeding and alone. With no idea how he got there, he desperately searches for a way to escape before it’s too late. A broken bone offers a slim chance at freedom, but a single mistake alerts his captor.

title: La nostra ultima estate
overview: Tommaso and Alex meet by chance on the seashore and discover a deep connection. As summer comes to an end, however, they begin to fear losing each other. Will their love survive the autumn, or will it remain only the memory of a special summer?

title: Rogue Trooper
overview: Rogue is a "Genetic Infantryman", a genetically-engineered, blue-skinned, manufactured super soldier who, alongside his three comrades, is searching for the Traitor General. His comrades are with him in the form of biochips—onto which a G.I.'s entire personality is downloaded at the time of death for later retrieval—and are named Gunnar (mounted on Rogue's rifle), Bagman (on his backpack) and Helm (on his helmet). Rogue is designed to be immune to almost all known toxins, can submerge in strong acid unaffected, and is able to withstand a vacuum on his bare skin.

title: Gato Encerrado
overview: What starts as a local search for a missing cat quickly spirals into a trap. To find the truth, a police officer is forced to survive an ambush orchestrated by the ghosts of his dark past.

title: Choked
overview: Shakona doesn't always want to be treated so nicely... sometimes she wants to feel like the world does: chaotic. Yet she can't get her devoted and loving boyfriend Eddie to meet her needs, so she goes to where all good decisions are made: a hookup app. Just as it seems like Shakona is finally letting go, she has the chance to take power into her own hands.

title: The Underground - Incident Report
overview: An unnamed Underground Agent has reported a strange happening on a recent mission.

title: Una Perra Andaluza: una dramarracha sobre el deseo en tres actos
Luminesence
overview: In a ruined city consumed by a lethal entity of light, a partially blind teenager and his older sister fight to survive. But when a mysterious encounter disrupts their fragile existence, they are forced to face their deepest fears and long-buried desires.

title: Bad Counselors
overview: After committing a crime on campus, two frat-stars pretend to be Christian camp counselors in order to fulfill court ordered community service.

title: Chapter 51
overview: An elusive serial killer known as the Hollywood Killer turns a high-profile film production into a grisly crime scene, murdering three actresses and casting a dark shadow over the troubled project. As fear, speculation, and chaos spread behind the cameras, the production becomes forever linked to a case that shocks Hollywood and remains unresolved. Years later, former FBI agent Thomas Scott reopens the cold case, revisiting the events surrounding the murders and uncovering secrets that refuse to stay buried.

title: The Welcome Table
overview: Tells the story of climate refugees across six continents, celebrating the voices and experiences of people living at the forefront of the climate crisis, displaced from their homes by climate disasters.

title: I suffer from depression and my final straw was a man who couldn't light a cigarette
overview: Set in a tavern in Kadıköy, A young man is supposed to light his friend’s cigarette, but he just can’t get the lighter to work. What seems like a small, almost meaningless moment starts to break the flow of everything around him.

title: Batman: Knightfall Part 1: Knightfall
overview: Arkham Asylum has been destroyed, and all its inmates have been unleashed upon Gotham City. As Batman races to round up some of his greatest enemies, he is pushed to his physical and mental limits and into a final confrontation with a new threat: the man called Bane!

title: Lowercase G
overview: This is a story about a crisis of faith, perpetuated by a holy sinner. This is a story about communion wafers that taste like cardboard, and prayers that feel like pantomimes. This is a story about something wholly unholy.

title: Blue
overview: Luce, a bright young student from a good family, falls for Loris, a reckless boy whose debts put them both in danger. She turns to Vittoria, a once-familiar friend now living in luxury, who convinces her to use erotic sites to pay off the debt. But, like dominos, every part of her life starts collapsing. The two girls won't leave until dawn, once Luce's debt is paid, but at what cost?

title: Ryan Hamilton: This Just Hit Me
overview: Leave it to Ryan Hamilton to get hit by a bus and have the last laugh — whether it's falling for his anesthesiologist or a dispensary trip with his mom.

title: ROOMINATION
overview: An established author Laura finds herself in the only place she was hoping to avoid- her unsettling therapy session with the peculiar Dr. Heigold. The more the therapy goes on, a way out seems more and more unlikely.

title: Beneath the Night
overview: A metro driver with colorful hair is unexpectedly chosen as the face of a public transport advertising campaign, blurring the lines between the visible and hidden.

title: Kill the Clue
overview: A party takes a mysterious turn when a guest is found dead!

title: Back In the Game
overview: Eight years ago, Jiale, a senior member in the gang, takes the blame for his brother and goes to prison. After his release, he wants to live peacefully in a small coastal town, away from the underworld. However, his former boss, Rong, intends to hand over the gang to him, while Huoshan, who rose to power thanks to Jiale's sacrifice, sees his return as a huge threat. As power, lies, and old grudges intertwine, Jiale has no choice but to return to the underworld. Along the way, he saves Jiehe, a girl with a music dream on the verge of despair, and she becomes a glimmer of light in his dark life. To protect the ones he cherishes and account for his past, he picks up the knife again. A thrilling gunfight breaks out in the dark alleys of the city, and he turns the tables time and again with his skills. Tearing off Huoshan's disguise, the truth from eight years ago comes to light.

title: Molière, Cyrano and the Young King
overview: During the Paris rebellion, young Louis XIV must be hidden from danger and is secretly replaced at court by a look-alike. Entrusted to the musketeer-poet Cyrano de Bergerac, Louis is sheltered within Madeleine Béjart’s traveling theater troupe, where the actor and aspiring playwright Molière has just joined – unaware their newest member is the future king of France. As Cyrano struggles to handle the arrogant and clumsy young king, he begins writing a bold play for the troupe. Molière, bursting with ideas, transforms the work with wit and heart, awakening his genius for comedy and deepening his secret feelings for Madeleine, while young Louis discovers the joy of theater and the power of friendship. But back in Paris, intrigue is brewing – can the young king return in time before the masquerade is revealed and embrace his true royal destiny?

title: Les Parfait(s) : Arnaques en Famille
overview: The Toussaint family are expert hustlers on the run who adopt the unassuming identities of the “Perfects” and settle in Scotland. As they juggle new jobs, nosy colleagues and a mysterious neighbor, their elaborate disguises, gadgets and insane schemes threaten to expose their double life.

title: Drones
overview: When a tech enthusiast subscribes to a groundbreaking Drone Butler service, he’s enamored by the technology’s intuition and uncanny attentiveness to his needs—until it begins to cross disturbing lines. DRONES is a sci-fi thriller that looks at our trust and dependence on tech, and how the ease of convenience can quickly devolve into something more sinister.  ​

title: Window.Water.Raining.Moving.Landscape.
overview: A juxtaposition of rainy landscapes.

title: Only Rebels Win
overview: Suzanne and Osmane meet in crisis-ridden Beirut. Osmane is a young Sudanese man without papers, searching for a better future; Suzanne is a widow with Palestinian roots more than twice his age. Against all odds, they fall in love.

title: Summer's Camera
overview: After her father passed away, Summer stopped taking photos. One day, she falls for Yeonwoo, the school's soccer star, and takes her picture with her late father's camera. When she develops the film, she finds mysterious photos of her father's high school lover. In these photos, Summer uncovers a secret about her father. Will she be able to pursue her first love and uncover her father's hidden truth?

title: The Eyes
overview: Seo-jin, a renowned photographer, is shattered by the sudden and mysterious death of her twin sister and sets out to uncover the truth. As her investigation deepens, an unseen presence begins to close in, twisting reality and driving her into a spiral of paranoia as her vision fades away. Now trapped in encroaching darkness, Seo-jin faces a terrifying revelation that shatters everything she thought she knew.

title: Deniz Göktaş: Ölü Deniz
overview: In Göktaş's second attempt to get himself into trouble, he tries to make sense of his fame as a comedian. As more friends leave Turkey due to political uncertainties, his audience keeps growing. Each encounter with political figures and famous intellectuals reminds him where he truly belongs. He studied psychology to solve all his problems, but coming to terms with Turkey's history cost him more than he expected. Everything feels connected, yet there is a disconnected head you simply cannot unsee.  Recorded on June 1st at the Harbiye Open Air Theater, Istanbul.

title: Pieces of a Foreign Life
overview: Woman flees war-torn Syria, leaving family behind. Seeking asylum in Bordeaux, she meets French lawyer who helps her rebuild life. Unexpected relationship forms between them amid her struggle to resettle.

title: LYTLE 2014
overview: An argument unfolds in the midst of everything else that has ever happened.

title: Welcome to the Jungle
overview: A group of quirky characters gets stuck in a dangerous jungle during a chaotic mission. Filled with confusion, criminals, and hilarious situations, they must work together to survive and find their way out.

title: Supergirl
overview: When an unexpected and ruthless adversary strikes too close to home, Kara Zor-El, aka Supergirl, reluctantly joins forces with an unlikely companion on an epic, interstellar journey of vengeance and justice.

title: The Invite
overview: Joe and Angela’s marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places. Have they reignited the spark or lit the match that burns it all down?

title: Jackass: Best and Last
overview: The fifth and final installment to Jackass franchise where the crew go on one last insane crusade.

title: Ananthan Kaadu
overview: This is a tale, which almost became a true story. It unfolds in the late Eighties and early Nineties, when the country was going through a dark phase both politically and socially a time when turmoil was writ all over the political scape of the nation.

title: The Djinn's Curse 2
overview: In a village at the foot of Mount Budo, Diana begins behaving violently after disappearing into the forest, forcing her husband Anas to kill her.

title: Jangan Buang Ibu
overview: Ristiana, a single mother, struggles to raise her three children after her husband left her with significant debt. Her decisions strain her relationship with her children. Despite the distance and longing, her three children remain devoted to their mother and strive to repair their relationship before it's too late.

title: Dreamboi
overview: A trans woman becomes entranced by the voice of an underground audio porn star. Torn between fantasy and reality, she drifts through the neon haze of Quezon City on a journey of desire, pain, and self-discovery.

title: Headline
overview: One headline, countless questions, and the fight for a single truth. What lies hidden behind the overnight changed story?

title: Black Box (Flight 298)
overview: A routine domestic flight turns into the flight from hell through a series of inexplicable phenomena and raw terror. Surreal encounters blur the boundaries between reality and nightmare. Passengers fight against all the odds in an attempt to survive while combating bizarre technological malfunctions, accelerating supernatural events and alien influences.

title: Landslide
overview: Amidst the riots in Poso, Kai and his older brother, Ringgo, who has Down Syndrome, are separated from their mother, Emmy. While searching for their mother, they encounter a police officer named Idham, who is on duty handling the riots. Idham helps search for Emmy, while taking Kai and Ringgo along on his journey through dangerous situations. An emotional bond like family begins to emerge between Idham, Kai, and Ringgo.

title: Sugar Beach
overview: A brilliant yet haunted valedictorian seeks refuge in a passionate throuple, but when their intoxicating world unravels, she must confront her past before it destroys her.

title: Avemmaria
overview: Felice lives in two dark rooms of a crumbling building with his father Raffaele, recently laid off, his mother Antonietta, too young and worn down by grief, his grandmother Filomena, always dressed in black and filled with resentment, and three brothers, with another on the way. In that world of poverty and violence, a boy like him can either be crushed or cling to his dreams. His imagination is his refuge, but in Pianura there's no room for fantasy - being poor and a dreamer is a fault. Yet his teacher, Giulia, recognizes his singing talent and tries to offer him new horizons. When Felice sees Neil Armstrong's footprint in his textbook, he realizes he too might leave Pianura and reach the moon.

title: Rik Mayall: Magnificent B'stard
overview: From early sketches to standout performances, Mayall's fearless comedy bursts with energy and intent, capturing a pivotal moment in British comedy while delivering pure entertainment.

title: A Matter of Life and Death
overview: Haya's convinced she's going to die before thirty, so she's living like it — loud, reckless, completely unfiltered, no brakes. Then one of her stunts goes wrong and lands her in the ER... right into Youssef. A heart surgeon. Calm, controlled, lives by a schedule. The human opposite of her in every way.  Naturally, she decides he's her destiny.  What follows is chaotic, funny, and a little bit ridiculous — neon nights, strange rituals, the kind of moments you can't plan for. Her countdown keeps ticking. His walls keep cracking. And somewhere in between, they both start remembering what it actually feels like to be alive.  A love story for anyone who's ever felt like too much.

title: Ingeborg Bachmann – Jemand, der einmal ich war
overview: Sandra Hüller portrays Ingeborg Bachmann on an imaginary day in Rome. Regina Schilling’s hybrid film weaves together reenactments, archival footage, and Bachmann’s own writings into a portrait that offers a refreshing new perspective on the author and positions her writings as a reference point in current debates on gender relations and power.

title: Carry On Jatta 4
overview: "Carry On Jatta 4" is the fourth installment of the iconic Punjabi comedy franchise, produced by Humble Motion Pictures, set for release on June 26, 2026. Expect a hilarious rollercoaster of misunderstandings, quirky characters, and laugh-out-loud moments, continuing the legacy of the beloved series.

title: De Gaulle: Liberté
overview: Part two of a two-part biopic following French army officer Charles De Gaulle's life and political commitment between 1940 and 1945, and trace his development towards a political career.

title: FANTASIA
overview: Diana is an imaginative girl who constantly runs and builds her own world out of domestic trauma. She doesn't believe in love until she encounters the anonymous who called themself as "Dewa Eros" in a note on a romance novel. This journey leads Diana to meet Cinta, the true embodiment of love.

title: Loose ends
overview: Danny and Mike, two gang members sent to kill a rat, find their mission thrown into disarray when Danny gets second thoughts moments before the hit.

title: Con City
overview: Follows a struggling family whose lives change when a receipt printer starts generating money after a lightning strike, leading to public chaos when society discovers the money-making machine.

title: CAMP
overview: Emily is the cause of two tragedies early in her life; her dad suggests she go to a Camp for troubled youth to ease her guilt. When Emily arrives, she is taken in by the other counsellors; they accept her as she is and wrap her in a veil of peace & forgiveness. Emily stands at the forefront of a new kind of life, but there’s a voice out there in the woods she can’t ignore, telling Emily to go home.

title: Landship
overview: The Battle of Passchendaele, 1917. For three years the great war has been waging, and the two armies find themselves entrenched along the four-hundred-mile Western Front. At the start of a pivotal allied offensive to break the stalemate, the nine-man crew of a British MKIV Tank set out to destroy a series of heavily defended German bunkers.

title: Slipworm or: The Ectophagic Liminal Leech Breach
overview: Investigating a parasitic breach caused by forbidden rituals, Paddy Mullins and the b’ys race to capture a Slipworm before it finds a new host.

title: Heartin
overview: Fate tosses a couple into an unexpected situation with an ex-girlfriend in the mix.

title: Madonna & Graham
overview: Graham Norton sits down with the 'Queen of Pop', singer-songwriter, record producer, actress, entrepreneur, charity founder and LGBT rights and gender equality activist Madonna. The pair discuss her lengthy career in which she has achieved 18 multi-platinum albums globally, seven Grammy Awards, two Golden Globe Awards, twenty MTV Video Music Awards and an induction to the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame.

title: Eyes I
overview: A set of eyes of several women.

title: The Punishment Tapes
overview: Julia, a renowned crime journalist celebrated for exposing and bringing down the notorious serial killer Gianni Lenzi, finds herself drawn into a darker chapter when she receives a mysterious package-a collection of disturbing snuff films. The sender: Milian, an infamous underground filmmaker known for his grotesque and brutal work. Invited to his secluded home for an exclusive interview, Julia agrees, driven by curiosity and the promise of another explosive story. But as the camera rolls and the truth begins to unravel, Julia discovers that Milian's latest production may be more personal-and more dangerous-than she ever imagined.

title: The Letter
overview: A young postwoman tries to rebuild her relationship with her father, coming to terms with the pain of abandonment, the weight of the past and new bonds.

title: Nicolás de Jesús' Now You See Me...
overview: Struggling fair owner Kesselring (Nicolás de Jesús) is given a unique opportunity to restore the fair to its former glory when his friend Dr. Goodkat (Fredy Roque) introduces him to Marcus Kelevra (Alexis Adrián), a man whose mysterious act will draw people back to the fair, at a deadly cost, and even sparking interest among his fellow fairgoers.

title: Blood Lines
